title: ProofArtifact
description: Canonical, frozen ProofArtifact schema v1 for the SocioProphet estate. This is the SINGLE source of truth for the `epistemicLevel` enum and the proof-artifact vocabulary. Consumers (identity, SCOPE-D, GBRG blast-radius/containment, ...) MUST reference this via $ref (directly or inside an allOf) rather than copy-pasting the enum or redefining the shape. It is intentionally permissive (additionalProperties: true, required = just `status`) so every existing consumer's documents validate against the base; each consumer tightens `required` and adds its own fields in its own allOf extension. See standards-storage#97 (remediation R2). Freezes the seed deck's 'ProofArtifact schema v1 frozen at Day 90' milestone.

epistemicLevel.description: Estate-canonical proof-CONFIDENCE axis, ordered strongest -> weakest. This is the ONE authoritative enum; do not re-list it elsewhere. `synthetic` means synthetic/not-real DATA and MUST NOT be overloaded to mean 'auto-generated code' (use a separate `generated` boolean for codegen). `rejected` = the claim was actively falsified.

status.description: Union of proof-outcome statuses across estate consumers. VIOLATION is the identity-domain term for a falsified invariant; FAILED/BLOCKED/BOUNDED/SYNTHETIC_ONLY are the SCOPE-D/GBRG terms. Consumers MAY narrow this enum in their own extension.

version.description: Schema-version tag a document MAY carry to self-identify against this canonical (frozen at 1.0.0).

schemaVersion.description: Legacy/compat per-domain version string (e.g. SCOPE-D '0.1.0'). Retained for backward compatibility; prefer `version`.

claim.description: The claim under proof. Accepts a bare string (identity domain) or a structured claim object (SCOPE-D / GBRG). Additional claim-graph fields are permitted.

claimType.description: Flattened claim type (containment domain uses top-level claimType rather than a nested claim object).

evidenceRefs.description: The evidence set backing this proof (references into the evidence plane).

domains.description: Abstract/analysis domains touched. Permissive at the canonical layer; consumers MAY constrain the item enum in their extension.

invariants.description: Claim-graph: named invariants and their pass/fail results.

provenance.description: Producer + integrity metadata for the artifact.

signature.description: Optional detached/embedded cryptographic signature over the artifact (forward-compat; not all consumers sign today).

replayHandle.description: Optional handle that lets a verifier deterministically re-run the derivation that produced this artifact (forward-compat).

derivation.description: Human-readable explanation of WHY this artifact holds.

declared_by.description: Producing agent identity (snake_case form, GBRG blast-radius).

generated.description: True if the underlying subject is machine-generated (codegen). Kept SEPARATE from epistemicLevel 'synthetic' on purpose.
